package.description: Reduce eye strain, help with Dyslexia and Visual Stress

en-US.description: Reduce eye strain, help with Dyslexia and Visual Stress
en-US.longDescription: ColorVeil adds a color filter over your screen and over any application you are using. It helps with eye strain, Dyslexia, Scotopic Sensitivity Syndrome, or Visual Stress. You can easily turn the filter on and off, and customize the filter color and opacity. Try any color or tint to see which one works best for you (for example choose Orange that is known to block out the blue light responsible for sleep deprivation). Easy to use and portable.
en-US.name: ColorVeil

zh-CN.description: 减轻眼疲劳，辅助改善阅读障碍与视觉压力
zh-CN.longDescription: ColorVeil 能为您的屏幕及正在使用的任何应用程序添加一层色彩滤镜。它有助于缓解眼疲劳、阅读障碍、暗适应敏感综合征或视觉压力。您可以轻松开启或关闭滤镜，并自定义滤镜颜色和透明度。尝试任意色彩或色调，找到最适合您的方案（例如选择公认能阻隔导致睡眠不足的蓝光的橙色）。操作简便，即开即用。
